items.stem: In Microsoft Defender XDR, what is an incident?

options.text: A group of related alerts that form a single attack story
options.rationale: Correct: correlation engines aggregate related alerts into one incident.
A raw event is not an incident on its own.
A firewall rule is unrelated to an incident.
A compliance policy is not an incident.

items.explanation: Correct: correlation engines aggregate related alerts into one incident.

items.stem: Which TWO are capabilities of Microsoft Defender XDR? (Select TWO.)

options.rationale: Correct: AIR investigates and can remediate threats automatically.

options.text: Advanced hunting using Kusto Query Language (KQL)
options.rationale: Correct: advanced hunting uses KQL to query collected data.

options.text: Automatically formatting hard drives on every alert
options.rationale: Incorrect: Defender XDR does not wipe drives on every alert.
Incorrect: certificate issuance is not a Defender XDR function.

items.explanation: Correct: AIR investigates and can remediate threats automatically.

T-SQL is used by SQL Server, not advanced hunting.
DAX is a Power BI formula language, not for hunting.
Bicep is infrastructure-as-code, not a query language.
